data.description:
## Description

**What**: Validation sprint orchestration: run /dso:sprint on a candidate epic of ≥1500 LOC across ≥3 stories using all the new mechanisms. Verify mechanical proxies pass (draft PR exists from Phase A; readable DSO-Story trailers; reviewer-findings.json + GitHubPRDefenseStore writes; final-PR DefenseStore returns attestations covering merged stories; leakage 5-case test matrix passes). Inline value-signal assertion: re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50%.
**Why**: Demonstrates that the mechanism reduces re-review surface in practice.

**Scope**:
- IN: Identify a candidate epic of ≥1500 LOC across ≥3 stories that does not depend on this epic's mechanisms (no circular dependency)
- IN: Run /dso:sprint end-to-end on that epic
- IN: Capture mechanical proxy verifications and the re-review ratio
- IN: Document results in a validation report committed to docs/findings/
- OUT: Achieving the headline <15% re-review target — filed as follow-on observability ticket

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the validation sprint runs end-to-end without manual intervention on a ≥1500 LOC, ≥3-story epic
  ← Satisfies: "SC8: Validation acceptance with inline value-signal"
- When this story is complete, all mechanical proxies pass: draft PR from Phase A; readable DSO-Story trailers; reviewer-findings.json + DefenseStore writes; final-PR DefenseStore returns attestations covering merged stories; leakage 5-case test matrix passes
  ← Satisfies: "SC8"
- When this story is complete, the inline value-signal assertion re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50% holds for the validation sprint
  ← Satisfies: "SC8: inline value-signal"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] The ≥1500 LOC validation sprint must use real story content (not synthetic). Identify the candidate epic or story batch BEFORE this story begins, and confirm the chosen work does not itself depend on this epic's behavior to merge. Document the chosen validation target in this story before implementation begins.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a plugin maintainer, the validation sprint runs the entire pipeline end-to-end on a real ≥1500 LOC epic and confirms re-review ratio < 50%
